title: SAML metadata handshake, schema validation, and admin onboarding flow
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Background: Customers onboarding SAML 2.0 IdPs frequently fail due to subtle metadata or certificate issues (malformed XML, missing EntityDescriptor fields, expired signing certs, or unexpected attribute formats). Current wizard surface only shows HTTP fetch success/failure and a raw XML preview. Goal: replace with a robust metadata handshake flow that (1) supports URL fetch and manual upload, (2) performs layered validation (XML schema, XML signature verification, cert validity/chain + grace window, required attributes mapping), (3) provides actionable, non-technical error messages and remediation steps in the Console, and (4) emits structured audit events and ties decisions to RBAC v2 admin controls (who can accept unverified metadata, rotate certs, or mark as trusted). Non-goals: implementing a full IdP discovery protocol or storing third-party private keys.
acceptance_criteria: Wizard accepts metadata via URL and file upload and persists original XML blob for audit
Layered validation runs automatically and lists discrete findings: schema errors, signature failures, expired certs, missing SPSSODescriptor, unsupported NameIDFormats
Admins with 'sso.admin' role can override non-critical warnings (and override action is recorded in audit logs with before/after), others cannot
Console shows inline remediation suggestions (e.g., 'Upload signing cert PEM', 'Enable IdP metadata endpoint TLS SNI') with links to help doc

All metadata import/validation events are emitted to the audit pipeline with stable event names and fields required by compliance (actor, timestamp, metadata_id, validation_status, failure_codes, original_blob_sha256)
If URL fetch fails due to TLS issues, wizard surfaces the TLS error and offers a one-click manual upload path
We have an automated E2E test harness that simulates: valid metadata, cert expired, broken signature, missing attributes, and manual override workflow

audit_notes: Fields required: actor_email, actor_id, action, metadata_id, original_blob_sha256, validation_status (PASS|WARN|FAIL), failure_codes (CSV), override_reason
Retention: store original metadata blob encrypted with KMS and record SHA256 in events. Exportable as part of compliance bundle.
rollout_plan: Phase 1: Backend validation and audit event contract + unit tests (staging only)
Phase 2: Console UX + staged rollout behind feature flag for internal customers
Phase 3: Gradual customer opt-in with monitoring for onboarding failure spikes
Phase 4: GA and include in public docs + runbook for Support
